units.source_text: 在一个月光明朗的晚上，我和诗人托喀手挽着手，一起离开超人俱乐部。

en.t: On a bright moonlit evening, the poet Tok and I left the Superman Club together, arm in arm.

units.source_text: 托喀一句话也不说，沉郁的很是反常。

en.t: Tok said not a single word and was so gloomy that it seemed quite out of character.

units.source_text: 没过多一会儿，我们路过一个亮着灯的人家，

en.t: Before long, we passed by a house with lights burning inside,

units.source_text: 从窗口里可以看到屋里面有雌雄夫妇河童，和三只小河童，围在桌子旁边正在吃晚饭。

en.t: and through the window we could see a male and female kappa couple and three little kappa gathered around the table, eating dinner.
